ABOUT TANISHKA ENERGY

Field-proven solar execution you can bank on.

Tanishka Energy Solutions is a registered partnership firm based in Haryana, dedicated to high-quality infrastructure execution and clean energy solutions. We specialise in utility-scale solar projects, rooftop installations, DC/AC electrical works, MMS assembly, piling and site civil groundwork.

With extensive field expertise and a commitment to quality and safety, we serve residential, commercial and industrial clients nationwide.
